description: Pinned hunter target attraction and selection. Controlled craft capacities and distances; original-target retention, saved-order strict comparisons, radar boundary and ignored/undetectable exclusions. Half-hour maintenance and shared fuel stock preserve craft list order before hunter selection. Flight consumption caps/refunds include zero-burn destinations and free patrol.
